directive: FOUNDER DIRECTIVE full security review — 8 areas, severity-rated findings, evidence required
summary: Real review completed. CRITICAL Builder brief email-claim bypass FIXED in code (session or ADMIN_API_KEY required). HIGH forgot-password account enumeration FIXED. HIGH missing security headers FIXED via middleware. HIGH plaintext App Service secrets and Next.js nested CVEs documented (KV migration / Next 16 need Founder-aware change — not rotated/forced here). Remaining MEDIUM/LOW tracked in plan.json.

verificationMethods.gitignore: git check-ignore -v exercised for .env/.env.local/.env.production/secrets.json/credentials.json/id_rsa; before: only .env*.local ignored; after: .env and siblings ignored, .env.example kept
verificationMethods.gitHistory: git log/name-only for .env/secret/credential adds; git log -S ADMIN_API_KEY= on tracked files shows example placeholders only; remote URL has no embedded token; .git/config remote is https://github.com/b06xob/Problems4Us.git
verificationMethods.workingTreeSecretPatterns: rg for sk_live_/ghp_/xox/BEGIN PRIVATE KEY/AccountKey — only test fixture path hit (tests/checkout-session.test.ts)
verificationMethods.prodHeaders: HEAD https://problems4us.com/ before fix: no CSP/HSTS/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy; X-Powered-By: Next.js present
verificationMethods.seoSurfaces: sitemap.xml public pages only (no /admin or /api); llms.txt has no admin routes; JSON-LD in layout is static brand schema only
verificationMethods.forgotPasswordProbe: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with unknown email returned generic ok message; code previously added deliverySent/deliveryChannel only when account existed
verificationMethods.appSettings: az webapp config appsettings list --name problems4us-linux --resource-group rg-problems4us — classified KeyVaultRef vs plaintext(len) without dumping values
verificationMethods.npmAudit: npm audit --json: high=4 critical=0 (brace-expansion, next→postcss/sharp, postcss, sharp). Bumped next 15.5.20→15.5.22. Force to next@16 declined (breaking).

findings.title: Production secrets stored as plaintext App Service settings
findings.exposure: Any principal with Microsoft.Web/sites/config/list can read ADMIN_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING, SMTP_PASSWORD, Application Insights connection string in cleartext from problems4us-linux. BREIVAX_BILLING_FORWARD_SECRET is already a Key Vault reference — others are not.
findings.rationale: Migrating to Key Vault references requires Founder-approved rewiring and must not be done as an in-band credential rotation during this review (standing DO NOT rotate credentials). Tracked for KV conversion.

findings.title: .gitignore did not cover .env / secrets.json / key material
findings.exposure: A future `git add .env` or secrets.json could be committed accidentally; only .env*.local was ignored.
findings.evidence: Updated .gitignore; git check-ignore now ignores .env, .env.production, secrets.json, credentials.json, id_rsa; .env.example remains tracked

findings.title: No SESSION_SECRET App Setting — session/reset pepper falls back to ADMIN_API_KEY
findings.exposure: ADMIN_API_KEY blast radius includes session token hashing and password-reset token hashing; compromising one key compromises both.
findings.rationale: Introducing SESSION_SECRET would invalidate live sessions and outstanding reset tokens (operational disruption). Recommend dedicated SESSION_SECRET via Key Vault without rotating ADMIN_API_KEY in the same change window.

findings.title: Builder brief export authorized by claimable email only
findings.exposure: GET /api/builder/briefs?email=<entitled>&problemId=… returned paid markdown/PDF briefs and could mint share URLs with no session cookie. Knowing or guessing any active Builder email bypassed paid-tier gate.
findings.evidence: src/lib/builder-brief-auth.ts + route requires session email match OR ADMIN_API_KEY; tests/builder-brief-auth.test.ts (5 cases) pass; Critical Intercom event published immediately

findings.title: Forgot-password response enumerated accounts via delivery fields
findings.exposure: When an account existed, response included deliverySent/deliveryChannel; when not, only generic message — enabling account existence oracle.
findings.evidence: src/app/api/auth/forgot-password/route.ts always returns GENERIC_FORGOT; delivery failures logged server-side only

findings.title: Admin UI stores ADMIN_API_KEY in sessionStorage
findings.exposure: XSS on admin origin could exfiltrate the owner key for the browser tab lifetime.
findings.rationale: Admin page is not in sitemap/nav; CSP middleware reduces XSS risk; moving to httpOnly cookie would be a larger UX change. Tracked as hardening.

findings.title: Password reset token properties verified
findings.verification: 32-byte base64url mint; SHA-256 peppered hash stored; 60-minute TTL; single-use (UsedAt); prior tokens invalidated; sessions deleted on consume; rate limits on forgot/reset; generic messaging after SEC-05 fix

findings.title: Admin routes use requireAdminAuth with timing-safe compare; fail closed if ADMIN_API_KEY unset (503)
findings.verification: src/lib/admin-auth.ts; ingest/github, ingest/hackernews, sources, AI, admin/* gated

findings.title: Missing security headers on production responses
findings.exposure: No CSP/HSTS/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy; X-Powered-By advertised Next.js — weaker browser XSS/clickjacking/MIME defenses.
findings.evidence: src/middleware.ts adds headers; next.config.ts poweredByHeader:false — pending deploy verification on problems4us.com

findings.title: Unauthenticated surface inventory (intentional)
items: POST /api/checkout/webhook (Stripe sig; currently 503 until STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET — intentional HOLD)
GET /admin page shell (API calls still need key)

findings.title: SEO/AEO surfaces do not advertise admin
findings.verification: sitemap.ts excludes auth/admin; live sitemap.xml clean; public/llms.txt clean; JSON-LD static

findings.title: Stripe webhook verify path is correct when configured
findings.verification: Raw body via request.text(); HMAC SHA-256; 300s replay tolerance; fails closed without secret (503); idempotent paid_early_access by stripeEventId

findings.title: Billing-forward auth is shared secret header, not body HMAC
findings.exposure: If BREIVAX_BILLING_FORWARD_SECRET leaks, attacker can grant Builder entitlements without Stripe proof (mitigated: secret is Key Vault ref; TLS).
findings.rationale: Company-wide forward design (HOLD vs isolated Stripe). Recommend request signing + timestamp in a later hardening task; secret already KV-backed.

findings.title: npm audit reports 4 high (0 critical)
findings.rationale: Patched within Next 15 line to 15.5.22. Remaining fixes require next@16 (breaking). Do not force major upgrade mid-security-review without regression QA.

findings.title: PII inventory and controls
holds: Conversion/funnel events (emailDomain preferred; some admin events retain email)
Third-party ingest titles/bodies (GitHub/HN) after moderation drop
findings.transit: HTTPS on problems4us.com (ARRAffinity Secure cookies observed)
findings.rest: Azure SQL — encryption-at-rest is platform default; connection string currently plaintext in App Settings (SEC-01)
findings.rationale: Data minimization for submissions emails already applied; further retention policy needs product decision

findings.title: Ingest XSS / moderation
findings.verification: UI renders Title/Summary as React text children (escaped). Moderation drops toxic/PII/secret-like patterns before DB (fail-closed drop). JSON-LD does not embed ingested content.

findings.title: Auth failures not structured into App Insights security events
findings.exposure: Failed logins return 401 but are not tracked via TELEMETRY_EVENTS — brute-force / credential stuffing harder to detect in Application Insights.
findings.rationale: Rate limits exist (PUBLIC_RATE_LIMITS auth-login). Adding auth_failure telemetry is a follow-up task in plan.json.

findings.title: App Insights configured; health exposes appInsightsConfigured boolean only
findings.verification: GET /api/health ops.appInsightsConfigured=true; no secret values in health JSON

findings.title: Single ADMIN_API_KEY is a broad owner credential
findings.exposure: One leaked key unlocks ingest, sources CRUD, AI tools, password-reset issue, entitlement grant/revoke, funnel/admin APIs, and (via pepper fallback) weakens session/reset crypto separation.
findings.rationale: Key not in client bundles (only sessionStorage after manual paste on /admin). Not recoverable from public API error bodies (401 Unauthorized). Rotation + split keys (ingest vs entitlement) need Founder sign-off — not performed per DO NOT rotate.

findings.title: SQL + OpenAI + SMTP credentials share App Service identity plane
findings.exposure: Compromise of App Service configuration plane yields database, AI spend, and mail relay credentials together.
findings.rationale: Addressed by SEC-01 Key Vault migration plan; Managed Identity for SQL recommended

founderDecisionsRequired: Approve Key Vault references for ADMIN_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_SQL_*, SMTP_PASSWORD, APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING (and optional SESSION_SECRET)
Approve Next.js 16 major upgrade window to clear remaining npm high CVEs
Approve ADMIN_API_KEY rotation after KV cutover (not before)

postDeployProbes.securityHeaders: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options present; X-Powered-By absent

remainingRisk: Plaintext App Settings (SEC-01/19/20) and Next.js nested high CVEs (SEC-14) remain until Founder-approved Key Vault migration and Next 16 upgrade.
